output.rationale: The study is an original epidemiological study using a time-series design to examine the association between PM2.5 and respiratory hospitalizations. It reports effect estimates (inverted U-shaped and S-shaped patterns) for PM2.5 exposure.

The study is an original epidemiological study that meets all inclusion criteria. It examines the association between PM2.5 exposure and respiratory ED visits (asthma exacerbations) in children using a quasi-Poisson regression model.

The study is an original epidemiological study using a case-crossover design to examine the association between PM2.5 exposure and asthma hospitalization. It reports relative risk estimates with confidence intervals.

The study meets all inclusion criteria: it is an original epidemiological study, examines PM2.5 exposure (as a component of the AQI), reports on respiratory hospitalizations/ED visits as the outcome, uses a case-crossover design, and provides quantitative effect estimates (ORs).

The study is an original epidemiological study using a case-crossover design to examine the association between PM2.5 exposure and respiratory hospitalizations. It reports relative risks with confidence intervals.
